pytest-failure-triager 1.0.0

- Initial release: Analyze pytest failure logs and produce a prioritized, actionable fix plan.
- Clusters failures by cause; ranks urgent issues (e.g. import/setup errors) first.
- Extracts key details (node id, file, message) and highlights minimal steps to repro.
- Offers concrete next actions, tailored re-run commands, and clarifying questions if data is missing.
- Emphasizes confidentiality and gives clear "done when" success criteria.
